clue.text: Fabulous creature Oberon heard riding on a dolphin

definitions.meaning: a creature of fable, half woman and half fish

definitions.text: Oberon heard riding on a dolphin
definitions.meaning: in A Midsummer Night's Dream Oberon recalls hearing a sea-maid singing on a dolphin's back

explanation.surface: A fairy king recalls a legendary sea creature carried along by a dolphin.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea-maiden with a fish's tail is a legendary being, and Shakespeare's fairy king remembers one singing astride a dolphin.

clue.text: Realm most devastated by turbulent confusion.

indicators.note: devastated suggests the words are wrecked and their letters thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A kingdom laid waste by stormy chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: A whirlpool, and by extension any state of violent turmoil.

clue.text: Student is surrounded by lots of paper — it's true to nature

definitions.note: an adjectival phrase standing for the noun: the quality of being faithful to life

indicators.note: surrounded by tells us the student and is sit inside the paper word

parts.note: a ream is a large quantity of paper, 500 sheets
L is the learner sign, a student driver
taken as written

explanation.surface: A learner buried under piles of paper insists it reflects real life.
explanation.definitionFit: In art, the faithful depiction of life as it is, without idealising.

clue.text: Original manuscript sought from a celebrity, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a document in the author's own hand
what a fan asks a famous person to sign

explanation.surface: A fan chases a famous person for an original handwritten document.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a writer's own handwritten copy and a famous person's signature collected by fans.

clue.text: Pre-arranged contest of the French and the Spanish

parts.note: du is French for 'of the'
el is Spanish for 'the'

explanation.surface: A fixed match between France and Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal fight between two people, arranged in advance with seconds and weapons.

clue.text: Girl holds key to the English craft of wickerwork

indicators.note: holds means the girl's name contains the key

parts.note: Coral is a girl's name
C is a musical key

explanation.surface: A girl holds the secret to the English art of basket weaving.
explanation.definitionFit: A small round boat made of wicker covered with hide, a craft woven from osiers.

clue.text: When single-handed, you can dine off these

definitions.text: When single-handed, you can dine off these

parts.words: When single-handed, you can dine off these
parts.note: eating utensils used in pairs in one hand, and also a simple piano tune often picked out with one finger of each hand

explanation.surface: Something you can eat with using just one hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Paired sticks held in one hand to eat East Asian food; also the name of an easy piano piece.

clue.text: Mass meeting of everyone carried by trains

indicators.note: carried by means the word for everyone rides inside the trains word

parts.note: trains gives RY
all means everyone

explanation.surface: Crowds arrive by train for a big gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: A large public gathering held to show support for a cause.

clue.text: He keeps medicinal items initially in a box

definitions.text: He keeps medicinal items initially in a box

indicators.note: in places those opening letters inside the box word

parts.note: a chest is a box

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letters of the words medicinal and items

explanation.surface: A pharmacist stores his remedies in a box.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines a pharmacist; 'in' puts MI (from 'initially') inside CHEST.
explanation.definitionFit: A pharmacist is a person who stocks and dispenses medicines.

clue.text: Egyptian goddess with name for having scoffed

parts.note: E abbreviates Egyptian, as in the currency sign for the Egyptian pound
Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin

explanation.surface: An ancient goddess with a name for gluttony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egyptian goddess' reads as one phrase, but Egyptian gives only E and the goddess is the Greek Ate.
explanation.definitionFit: Scoffed is slang for devoured greedily, so food that has been consumed.

clue.text: Lightweight woman first to perform on stage

indicators.note: first says the woman's name comes before the weight

parts.note: Ena is a woman's name
CT is a carat, a very small unit of weight

explanation.surface: A slight woman is the first to take to the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: To act out a role or play in front of an audience.

clue.text: Soothing agency in new motel? Right

indicators.note: in signals the right goes inside the rearranged motel
new tells us the motel is made over, its letters reshaped

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property against a debt

explanation.surface: A guest asks whether a new motel offers something calming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns MOTEL into EMOLT, and 'in' puts LIEN within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A softening cream or lotion acts as an agent that soothes the skin.

clue.text: Cheat by overcharging by half on beer

parts.note: to sting is slang for overcharging someone

indicators.note: half takes the first of the two letters of the word on

explanation.surface: A barman rips customers off by charging half as much again for ale.
explanation.definitionFit: An old name for a strong, well-aged ale.

clue.text: Ninevite appearing in the role of Damascene?

parts.note: as means in the role of
a Damascene is a native of Damascus, a Syrian

explanation.surface: Someone from Nineveh is cast as a man from Damascus.
explanation.walkthrough: Nineveh was the capital of ancient Assyria.
explanation.definitionFit: Nineveh was the capital of the ancient Mesopotamian empire, so its citizen belongs to that people.

clue.text: Road junction provided for part of the plant

definitions.meaning: a motorway interchange whose loops form a four-lobed shape
a single trefoil of a clover

explanation.surface: A motorway interchange is planned to make room for part of a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: A highway interchange shaped like a four-leaf trefoil, and literally the foliage of a clover.

clue.text: Steps taken in the rejection of 25 murals

indicators.note: the rejection of turns the held letters back to front, as something rejected is turned away
taken in means the letters are held within the run of 25 and murals

parts.note: 25 stands for the answer at 25-down, a word for an attempt, placed before murals

explanation.surface: Dance moves condemned in a review of some wall paintings.
explanation.walkthrough: With 25-down written in, STAB MURALS read backwards holds the run of five letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A Cuban ballroom dance, defined by its steps.

clue.text: Salmon-spear outside church in this city

indicators.note: outside puts the fishing spear around the church

parts.note: a leister is a pronged spear for catching salmon
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A fishing spear is left outside a church in town.
explanation.walkthrough: LEICESTER is a city in the English Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: An English Midlands cathedral city, the clue's 'this' pointing to the solution itself.

clue.text: Detailed work in America covered by 8, mostly

indicators.note: covered by means the American word for work sits inside the other
mostly drops the final letter from the answer at 8-down

parts.note: 8 refers to the answer at 8-down, meaning having scoffed
labor is the American spelling of labour, work

explanation.surface: A detailed job carried out in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Elaborate means intricate and carefully worked out in detail.

clue.text: Poet's version of The Merry Saint

definitions.note: reads as 'poet is', so stands for a noun

indicators.note: a version of something is a rewritten form of it, here a reshuffle

explanation.surface: A poet's adaptation of a story about a jolly holy man.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhymer or versifier, usually a second-rate writer of verse.

clue.text: Moderate Russian soldiers? An Arab chief arrested five

parts.note: men means soldiers, the ranks

indicators.note: arrested means the five is caught and held inside the chief

parts.note: a sheik is an Arab chief
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Soldiers seize five men, including an Arab leader.
explanation.walkthrough: The Mensheviks were the moderate faction of Russian socialists opposed to the Bolsheviks.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the less radical wing of the Russian Social Democratic Party.

clue.text: One pound raised in prison for the club

indicators.note: in puts the one and the turned pound inside the prison word

parts.note: nick is slang for prison
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: raised in a down clue turns the pound abbreviation upwards

explanation.surface: A pound smuggled into jail for the club's funds.
explanation.definitionFit: An old golf club with a lofted head, roughly a nine iron.

clue.text: Dress a river fish

parts.note: a ray is a flat fish

explanation.surface: Clothing for a fish from the river.
explanation.definitionFit: To array is to clothe or deck out in finery.

clue.text: Search thoroughly for smuggled wine

parts.note: to run goods is to smuggle them, past tense ran
sack is an old name for a dry white wine

explanation.surface: Customs men hunt high and low for contraband wine.
explanation.definitionFit: To ransack is to go through a place hunting for something, leaving it in disorder.

clue.text: Sad tale of politician kept back by new boss

indicators.note: kept back by means the politician goes behind the remade boss
new signals the word boss is remade

parts.note: a Tory is a British Conservative politician

explanation.surface: A gloomy account of a politician held back by a new boss.
explanation.definitionFit: A tearjerking account told to win pity.

clue.text: A flight member's fixed gaze, by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it says a word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a stare is a fixed gaze

explanation.surface: A staircase climber gazes fixedly.
explanation.definitionFit: A single step forming part of a staircase.

clue.text: Fuss about new painting

indicators.note: about means the fuss word goes around the new

parts.note: a to-do is a fuss

explanation.surface: A commotion over a new artwork.
explanation.definitionFit: A tondo is a circular picture or carved relief.

clue.text: Unusual, we note, for an oppidan

indicators.note: unusual tells us the letters of we note are put in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Something odd we notice about a town dweller.
explanation.definitionFit: An oppidan is a town-dweller, as opposed to a college or country resident.

clue.text: Attempt to upset sportsmen

indicators.note: to upset, in a down clue, flips the word so it reads from the bottom up

parts.note: bats are batsmen, players in cricket

explanation.surface: Trying to unsettle the players.
explanation.definitionFit: A stab is a try or go at something.

clue.text: In which one must always, be properly dressed

definitions.text: In which one must always, be properly dressed

parts.words: In which one must always, be properly dressed
parts.note: dressed in the military sense of soldiers forming a straight line, not wearing smart clothes

explanation.surface: A setting where formal attire is required.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers who dress their ranks stand in a straight line.

clue.text: Expect a visitor at Christmas

parts.note: the waits were bands of carol singers going from door to door at Christmas

explanation.surface: Looking forward to a festive caller.
explanation.definitionFit: To await is to look forward to or be ready for.

clue.text: Commission unobtainable by Lothario

parts.note: a rake is a womanising libertine, like the seducer Lothario
off, as a dish no longer available on the menu

explanation.surface: A womaniser who cannot get a fee.
explanation.definitionFit: A share of profits taken, often illicitly, as a cut.

clue.text: White horse, possibly, causing damage

explanation.surface: A white horse that wrecks things.
explanation.definitionFit: A wave that crashes white on the shore, and a person who smashes things.
